name: Gabi Cord Pull On Pants, Java
desc: TOAST's simple Gabi pants are shaped with easy legs that taper towards long cropped cuffs. Crafted from organic cotton cord with a comfortable elasticated waist, then finished with back welt pockets, belt loops and a faux fly.
details: Side pockets and back welt pockets
Regular fit, sits below the waist
why: soft cotton cord, elastic waist, easy tapered leg, brown
reason: Three of the nine pieces she has saved are TOAST corduroy trousers. This is the same house's pull-on cord pant in a warm brown she doesn't have yet.

name: MHL Side Vent Skirt, Irregular Spun Cotton, Cocoa
desc: The MHL Side Vent Skirt has a regular A-line cut and midi length, in midweight irregular spun cotton with a dry hand feel, in a colour exclusive to MHL. A double hook-and-bar waistband, slant pockets and side vents, finished with an exaggerated belt loop at the back and a reinforced back patch pocket.
why: midweight cotton A-line midi, side vents for stride, cocoa
reason: She saved two A-line midi skirts in cord and one in tweed. Margaret Howell's workwear line makes the same shape in dry, textured cotton, and it was on your original brand list without ever making the closet.

name: Annie Skirt, Green
desc: The Annie Skirt is a functional wrap skirt with a mid-calf length and an adjustable waistband. It features a large central utility pocket and an asymmetrical silhouette, and is made from a lightweight olive green cotton/linen/ramie blend fabric. It's got a gentle drape and soft hand, and requires no break-in at all, making it ideal for the warmer seasons.
details: Sold by Standard & Strange, W'menswear's US stockist
why: lightweight cotton-linen-ramie wrap skirt, adjustable waist, olive
reason: W'menswear is her second most saved label, three pieces in, all trousers. The Annie is their skirt, in the same heavy cotton, from the same shop that carries the Wendy trousers she saved.

name: Hudson Pant in Wool Flannel, Navy
desc: Pull-on waist, roomy pockets, 100% wool. Alex Mill calls these the easiest pants ever: a drawstring waistband, a wide straight leg and side pockets, in navy wool flannel.
details: Hand wash cold or dry clean
why: wool flannel, wide straight leg, pull-on waist, navy
reason: Her tweed skirt heart says she likes a proper wool cloth. These are the trouser version: navy flannel with the pull-on ease of the cord pants she keeps saving.

name: Classic Jumpsuit in Mulberry Corduroy
desc: A fall wardrobe staple: the Classic Jumpsuit in Mulberry Corduroy has a cropped tapered leg, an elasticized waist and a concealed zipper with decorative buttons, in soft, stretchy corduroy you'll want to live in all season.
why: stretch corduroy, elastic waist, cropped tapered leg, mulberry
reason: The first thing she saved was TOAST's cord culotte jumpsuit. This is the corduroy jumpsuit from Mixed by Nasrin, added to the closet yesterday, in a deep mulberry.

name: Corduroy Drop Pocket Cargo Pants, Espresso Brown
desc: A utility pant: baggy, wide tubular legs modified from Big Bud Press's Action Pants, with a full elastic waistband and cotton drawstring, huge cargo drop pockets on the legs with brass snaps, and deep front and back pockets. Super roomy, made from a luxe 100% cotton 8-wale corduroy. Sizing on this oversized style is flexible; most size down.
details: Cargo drop pockets with brass snaps
why: heavy cotton cord, very roomy leg, drawstring waist, espresso
reason: New label. Big Bud Press in Los Angeles makes cotton workwear in sizes XXS to 6X. Cord plus cargo pockets is her cord trousers with the volume turned up.

name: Gaby Carpenter Jumpsuit, Black
desc: Loup's carpenter-style jumpsuit in 100% cotton. Machine washable, made in New York.
why: sturdy cotton, carpenter utility cut, black
reason: New label. Loup is a small New York maker with a whole family of utility jumpsuits. A black cotton carpenter suit sits right between the cord jumpsuit and the heavy trousers she has saved.

name: Classic Full-Circle Twill Linen Midi Skirt, Moss Green Herringbone
desc: A full-circle midi skirt handmade in Lithuania from 100% twill linen woven in a herringbone. Also offered in wild plum and night navy herringbone, willow plaid and oak tartan.
details: Other colours: wild plum, night navy, willow plaid, oak tartan
why: breathable linen twill, full circle skirt that moves, dark moss herringbone
reason: New label. Son de Flor makes linen in Lithuania. A herringbone twill circle skirt has the texture of her tweed and cord skirts with real room to spin.
